candidate.description: Prefer visual attempt_frame_number launch anchors, collapse sub-half-period visual duplicates by cadence support, insert only one cadence slot bracketed by compatible visual launches, and use the same slots for batch and live output

anchor_review.floating_ball_glitch: The incompatible frame-4642 visual anchor was suppressed in favor of cadence-supported frame 4624, but reassigning finalized histories by raw launch anchor introduced new sequence errors.
anchor_review.baseline_missing_and_extra: The retained Stage 2 output had already removed the baseline extra launch and one missing launch through durable ownership. The remaining missing #34 was not separated by additional credible visual launch evidence, so Stage 3 could not infer it without contradicting its evidence rule.

verification.candidate_unit_tests: 81 focused detector tests passed, including missed visual launch, false visual launch, pause, startup/shutdown, floating-ball glitch, and delayed-contact scenarios

sample2.result: regression: 47 attempts instead of the guarded 48

decision_reason: The candidate reduced evaluation accuracy from 92.7% to 91.1% and regressed the sample2 stable guard from 48 attempts to 47. Its implementation and candidate-only tests were reverted; commit 235683b remains the retained detector behavior.
